- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested restaurant options for light dinner in Yishun:

- [USER] User asked why people like to sleep so much.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Explained that people like to sleep because it is essential for good health and well-being, playing a role in physical and mental restoration, hormone regulation, and memory consolidation. 
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Mentioned that lack of sleep can lead to fatigue, decreased productivity, mood swings, and weakened immune function.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Noted that sleep is enjoyable and relaxing, and that most adults need about 7-9 hours of sleep per night, though individual needs may vary.
